verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is a skill format, repository and Skills API rather than an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence does not show one. What it does show is Claude Code acting as an MCP client (connecting to MCP servers), plugins that can bundle third-party MCP servers, and an Agent SDK in-process MCP server for defining custom tools. These are client-side, adjacent, or developer building blocks, not an official MCP server that agents connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
